description: Email a pay link for one booking, or for a client's unpaid sessions and invoices. Returns a preview first and only acts when confirm=true. No money moves through the assistant. This only sends a request the client pays on Appty. Group spots, packages, and fees are not emailed.

booking_id.description: Email a pay link for this booking. Pass this or client_id.

client_id.description: Email a pay reminder for each unpaid session and invoice this client has. Pass this or booking_id.

confirm.description: Set true only after the caller has seen a preview and wants it done. Anything else, including the string "true", is a preview and changes nothing.

name: send_pay_link
title: Send a pay link
